subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `memory status` and JSON status report the vector store as ready from persisted `vectorDims` without a current-process sqlite-vec probe, with `--deep` remaining the live readiness check?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow and proven, but it deliberately changes what the status contract means for existing operators and JSON consumers.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing from metadata while `--deep` remains the live probe.

options.title: Keep Ready As Live Probe
options.body: Require revised wording or a separate indexed-vector field if `Vector store: ready` must mean sqlite-vec loaded successfully in the current process.

options.title: Pause For Replacement Contract
options.body: Leave this PR open or redirect it if maintainers want a different memory status contract for the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing from metadata while `--deep` remains the live probe.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is assigned on the live PR and has recent memory-core migration/release history on the affected files.
